correctness.rationale: The exact graph neighbor equations are proved; the four pair-action types form an exhaustive partition. Disjoint admissible total sets exclude mixed equal/unequal pair types for r>=2. In the remaining two cases the necessary constraints force and suffice for t=1 or r+1 matched actives, the two polarizations, or n=2r and X=Y=r. Counts are binomial orbit counts; K_{n,n} uniformity yields exactly two profiles. Direct independent 407808-action-profile check, plus 378 exact multinomial checks, passed. The universal proof does not depend on the finite checks.

value.rationale: General-graph NP-hardness for strict nonmonotone public-goods patterns motivates natural exactly solvable graph families. A crown graph is a canonical regular dense graph obtained from K_{n,n} by deleting one matching; the proof identifies every equilibrium, exact active-size distribution and n=2r resonance, while the same game on K_{n,n} has only two equilibria. This quantifies graph-perturbation sensitivity and strategic multistability on an infinite graph family.
